what: Every call under scripts\ that reaches the VPS, what it sends, and the class it needs. Read from the code, not from script names. The ops repo's DEPLOY-IDENTITIES.md section 2 is corrected from this. tests\test-remote-command-map.ps1 keeps it in step with the scripts.
key: script|scope|via plus anchor: scope is the function the call sits in (<top> outside one); anchor is text that belongs to the call, from the whole lines it spans or, when those are not unique, from the 3 lines above it, and it names exactly one call with that script, scope and via (#2498). No position number, so a call inserted elsewhere moves no row.

classes.stage: write or check a stage folder or a file the deploy owns

classes.admin: needs Administrator: install, service, task registration, ACL, firewall, keys, secrets, or work outside the gate verbs
classes.transport: a helper that carries what its caller hands it; the caller is the row that counts
